properties.title: Burning Platform, Off Empire, LA
properties.content: At 1700 CST, on 16MAR, USCG contact NOAA SSC about a platform on fire. A small platform fire broke out on Baptiste Collette Bayou due to welding near a storage tank of crude oil. Three people vacated the platform and no one is believed to still be on it. A Port Authority boat from the Coast Guard is on the scene. There has been no oil released at this point, but USCG has requested a trajectory for the full release of the storage tank.

properties.title: Hydraulic Fluid Release, West Delta 117, LA
properties.content: On 18NOV, USCG MSU Morgan City contact NOAA SSC about a release of hydraulic fluid. During a P&A operations, Wild Well Containment reported 40 gl of "green-biodegradable" hydraulic fluid was release at depth (~ 200 ft). The is a sheen reported at the surface of 1,300 ft by 1,300 ft. USCG is requesting a trajectory and fate analysis.
